validators.category: Project-Specific External / Usability / UI Standards Validation
validators.notes: Managed sandbox launch failed with Chrome SIGABRT/kill EPERM, but the same npm script passed when Chrome was allowed to launch outside the sandbox. The passing run produced 18 screenshots and findings for autocomplete, search recovery, recommendations, and public wholesale search.
Run after Playwright was added as a devDependency; npm reported 0 vulnerabilities in Generation 3 and Generation 4 gate checks.

LaTeX compilation remains useful because the client-facing report and deck are core outputs. Generation 4 compiles confirmed the normalization and browse-routing narrative renders into PDFs. Generation 6 report-status correction and competitor benchmark report update both regenerated the assessment PDF successfully. Generation 8 compiled the two-page local school PTA opportunity brief successfully. Generation 9 recompiled the problem-only revision successfully. Generation 10 compiled the complete High Country evidence report successfully. Generation 11 compiled the owner-outreach High Country report as a 17-page Northvalley PDF, then the same-query competitor refinement as a 30-page Northvalley PDF. The customer-experience executive narrative refinement and final executive page design review kept the PDF at 30 pages after rebuilding from saved evidence.

Text extraction and representative rendered pages continue to provide useful PDF evidence. Generation 4 checks verified updated normalization, UCLA/Bruins, and browse-routing content. Generation 6 report-status correction verified the stale GitHub-blocked copy was removed and page 6 still rendered cleanly. The competitor benchmark report update verified the new comparison text and rendered the competitor/final pages cleanly. Generation 8 verified the local school PTA report text, two-page count, and rendered page layout. Generation 9 verified the score/proposal text was removed and both rendered pages remained readable. Generation 11 verified the High Country owner pages, same-query competitor references, customer-experience executive narrative, final page 3 customer-effort visual, full competitor dataset pages, organic/paid reference, concept summary, and final prior-evidence appendix rendered cleanly, and that extracted text omitted stale article/scorecard/demographic/ranking/technical-first framing.

Generated the 36-query Boxercraft normalization matrix across retail search, rendered autocomplete, public wholesale search, and visible browse paths. Produced 60 screenshots and five accepted findings/signals.

Generated the GEN-006 competitor benchmark across public Shopify catalog feeds, rendered search/autocomplete/browse samples, and explicit Concepts Sport/Fanatics limitation records. One interrupted exploratory run led to a tighter catalog-plus-rendered-sample strategy.

Generated all-node browse/search/autocomplete parity evidence across public Boxercraft collections. An early run exposed methodology cleanup needs for merchandising-node classification and broad handle queries; a later run exposed 429 rate-limit handling needs. The final rate-limit-aware run completed with 96 collections discovered, 93 non-empty nodes evaluated, and no warnings or node errors.

Generated the High Country combined ecommerce evidence/report. Useful for Shopify public catalog/search/suggest evidence plus rendered pages, screenshots, cart, policy/support, and explicit benchmark limitations. Playwright required unsandboxed browser launch in this environment.
